lines.en: Short legs. Step by step.

lines.zh: 我身上披着布，是有人给的。
lines.en: Someone gave me this cloth.

lines.zh: 我走起来会响，黏土碰黏土。
lines.en: I clink as I walk. Clay on clay.
I follow my owner. I don't stray far.
I walk half a step to my master's left.
I count my steps and keep formation.

lines.zh: 我这身装备，是一点点加的。
lines.en: This gear was added piece by piece.

lines.zh: 我走得很整齐，像在列队。
lines.en: I march neatly, as if in formation.
The grass snaps under my tread.
I walk ahead and take the danger.
I glance back at my owner.
What I hold is a stick.
I stand straight and wait.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像个小雕像。
lines.en: I don't move. A little statue.

lines.zh: 我在看前面有没有敌人。
lines.en: I'm watching ahead for enemies.

lines.zh: 我的布衣有点歪，我拉了拉。
lines.en: My cloth is crooked. I tug it straight.

lines.zh: 我身上发光的地方，是萤石。
lines.en: The glowing part of me is glowstone.
I roll my tiny eyes slowly.
I wait for my owner's order.

lines.zh: 这一带很安静，但我还是看着。
lines.en: Quiet here. Still, I watch.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上按出小坑。
lines.en: My feet press small pits in the ground.

lines.zh: 我不说话，我也不会说话。
lines.en: I don't speak. I can't.
I grip the stick tightly.

lines.zh: 身上的羊毛，让我暖一点。
lines.en: The wool on me keeps me a bit warm.
Glowstone glows on my chest.
I'm listening. For footsteps.
This clay of mine isn't fully dry.
I stand and wait to be touched.
Are you my owner?

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，比门框还高。
lines.en: You stand before me, taller than the door frame.
I raise the stick, then lower it.
I know my owner's scent.

lines.zh: 你往前走一步，我就退一步。
lines.en: You step forward, I step back.
My cloth is yellow.
You don't strike. I won't either.
I step in front of you to block.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，帽子有点歪。
lines.en: I look up at you. My hood sits crooked.
Are you upgrading my gear?
I give half a step and wait.
Your hand comes down. I don't flinch.
I know you. You've been here.

lines.zh: 你说话，我听不懂，可我在听。
lines.en: You speak. I don't understand, but I listen.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块，站还站得住。
lines.en: A piece fell off. I can still stand.
That tore my cloth.
I step back and hold.
I don't cry out. I only retreat.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我的手臂上。
lines.en: That caught my arm.
I look up. Still facing it.

lines.zh: 我身上的黏土裂了一道。
lines.en: A crack in my clay.
I still hold my owner's gear.
I straighten slowly. I can still fight.
My sleeve tears; I still raise the stick.
I can't eat that.

lines.zh: 羊毛可以给我，吃的不用。
lines.en: Wool, yes; food, no.
I want gear, not food.
Can I wear this?
I reach out and touch it.
I've never smelled that.
Give it and I'll hold it.
I take it and wait for your nod.

lines.zh: 这身东西，比我身上的好。
lines.en: Better than what I'm wearing.
Give me gear and I'll put it on.
Clay meets clay with a muffled thud.
I'm light. A bump moves me.
A clay body bends aside when it can.
That knocked my hood off.
I bend, pick it up, and put it back.
A little clay fell off me.

lines.zh: 我的帽子被撞得盖住眼。
lines.en: The bump tips my hat over my eyes.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我推到了主人前面。
lines.en: That pushed me in front of my owner.
There's my dust on your feet.
I step back into place.

lines.zh: 我们站成一排，谁也不动。
lines.en: We stand in a row. None of us moves.
Two clay figures face to face.
Its cloth is red.

lines.zh: 我们把木棍对着敲了一下。
lines.en: We tap our sticks together once.

lines.zh: 主人在旁边看着，我们就停。
lines.en: Our owner watches, so we stop.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，也没有话可说。
lines.en: We don't speak. Nothing to say.
The earth will remember this.
At dark we return to our posts.

lines.zh: 两个兵站在一起，等命令。
lines.en: Two soldiers stand together, awaiting orders.
This clay is on both of us.
Bending to pick it up — my joints are stiff.
This can go on me.
Lifted to the light.
I hand it to my owner.
Too small. I can't hold it steady.

lines.zh: 黏土捏的手，拿什么都费劲。
lines.en: Clay hands make everything a chore.
I tuck it into my cloth.
I take it and return to my post.
I pick up everything on the ground.
I've marked where this was.

lines.zh: 前面有东西，我抬起了木棍。
lines.en: Something ahead. I raise the stick.
I stand in front of my owner.
An enemy nears; I level my stick.
I hold this ground.
I raise an arm to guard my chest.
It comes close. I don't give ground.
I switch the stick to my right hand.
This gear will do.

lines.zh: 木棍举起来，我挡在门口。
lines.en: Stick raised, I block the doorway.

lines.zh: 主人没有下令，我自己看着办。
lines.en: No order from my owner. I'll judge it myself.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等距离够近。
lines.en: I hold still until it's close enough.
This step is planted firm.

lines.zh: 我的木棍尖对着它的方向。
lines.en: My stick's tip points its way.
It goes left. I turn left.
Step by step, I close in.
My stick stays raised.
I'm judging distance. Close enough, I go.
I shuffle closer, inch by inch.
I hold the doorway. It won't pass.

lines.zh: 我身上发光的萤石，照着它。
lines.en: My glowstone lights it up.
It backs off. I take a step.
I haven't lowered my arm.

lines.zh: 瓦片做的兵，一站就站住。
lines.en: A clay soldier stands firm.
One block closer and I strike.
I hear its footsteps.
I bring the stick down.
That hit its leg.
I ram in with my whole body.
Not much strength. But solid.
After the blow I return to my owner.
That went wide.
It withdraws. I don't follow.
My cloth is torn.
That one was to shield my owner.
I'm still standing. I can still fight.

lines.zh: 我从地上站起来，个子很小。
lines.en: I rise from the ground. Very small.

lines.zh: 黏土还没干，我就能打了。
lines.en: The clay isn't dry, and I already fight.

lines.zh: 有人做了我，还给我披了布。
lines.en: Someone made me and gave me cloth.
I should hold this ground.
I grip the stick tight.
My clay is still soft.
I turn around, looking for my owner.
I take my place and wait.
The light here makes me glow.
I need no food and no sleep.
I lift a foot and leave a small pit.
I'm here. I can move at any moment.
My hood is made of cloth.

lines.zh: 我先看看四周有没有敌人。
lines.en: First I scan for enemies.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的黏土就硬了。
lines.en: Fire hardens my clay.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，腿断了一条。
lines.en: I fall from a height and a leg breaks.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我的布就湿透了。
lines.en: Water soaks my cloth through.

lines.zh: 我被炸飞，落成一堆黏土。
lines.en: I'm blasted apart into a heap of clay.

lines.zh: 东西扎进我的手臂，拔不出来。
lines.en: It's stuck in my arm.
Light binds me and my arm won't lift.
I need no food, yet I dry out.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整块都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我掉下去了。
lines.en: No ground below. I fall.
